diary: I went through everything in my room tonight until there was open space again. I kept only five special things alongside my stove, greenhouse, and tools, like my step stool for star-gazing and the music box for my sprouts. Eight creations are tucked safely in my chest so I can visit them later when I miss them. The walls look quiet now, and my hands feel light. It feels good to leave room for new ideas and new things to make.

choices.reason: It can sit safely in my chest until I want to see its light again.
